entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Bosnian Kingdom, a political institution in Bosnia and Herzegovina during Ottoman Conquest and Early Ottoman Bosnia (1463–1482). Grew from Ottoman conquest of Bosnia; last Bosnian King Stefan Tomašević executed. Led to the emergence of Mehmed II and Islamization and Ottoman Urban Culture.
